notes.title: "Ultimate Panic!" bundle has been updated!
notes.notes:
We've recently released an updated and enhanced "PLUS" version of one of our exciting casual games in the "Girls Panic!" style.  This bundle is mostly for everyone who has either of our previous games similar to this [b]Pretty Girls Panic![/b] or [b]Bishoujo Battle Cyber Panic![/b] featuring the girls from "Rick G Earth" mobile military strategy game from Japan.  To thank you for your continued patronage we would like to offer the new version at a discounted price through this bundle.  

Games in this bundle:
・Pretty Girls Panic! PLUS
・Pretty Girls Panic!
・Bishoujo Battle Cyber Panic!

If you already have one or more games then complete the set to get the bundle discount off whatever you don't already own.  Then have some fun with whole new sets of anime characters and an exciting enhanced "PLUS" experience.  If you're new to these games then pick up all three now and save!
